title: podman machine info: report the current machine's vmtype
body:
<!-- Thanks for sending a pull request! -->

Fixes: #29139
`podman machine info` reported `VMType` — and the config/image directories and the machine count — from the **system default provider** only. With a default of `libkrun` but a running `applehv` machine, it printed `vmType: libkrun`, while `podman machine ls` correctly showed `applehv`.

`hostInfo()` now enumerates machines across all providers via `shim.List(provider.GetAll(), …)` (the same path `podman machine ls` uses) and reports `VMType` plus the image/config directories from the **current** (running/starting, otherwise default) machine's provider, with `NumberOfMachines` counted across providers. When no machine exists it falls back to the system default provider.
 
 Followed the conversation of the issue to solve it
